hook: "this is a PRIME EXAMPLE of why native style creative wins"
body: A meta-observation with a linked example: a handwritten note on a cup earned 600k views in 5 hours because nobody scrolls past a handwritten note — while everybody scrolls past a rendered product shot. The author tests thousands of creatives weekly and the "ugly" ones keep beating the beautiful.
idea: The handwritten note is the ultimate thumb-stop: human imperfection beats rendered perfection, proven at 600k views in 5 hours.
sequencing: Receipt: 600k views in 5 hours on an article post.
Contrast: nobody scrolls past a handwritten note; everybody scrolls past a rendered product shot.
Authority: we test 1000s of creatives a week.
Rule: the ugly ones keep beating the beautiful.
formatting: Short text post + linked media. Punchy contrast structure.
why_it_works: The 600k-in-5-hours receipt plus the binary contrast (nobody vs everybody) makes the rule feel like physics, not opinion.
what_to_steal: The handwritten-note-on-packaging creative for LC: a thank-you note on the jewelry box / packing slip, photographed natively — it's the format's namesake and LC ships the physical moment it needs.

hook: "Lanqin Lozenges's Monkey Lily suddenly disappeared last night!!"
body: A brand news post: Lanqin Lozenges' Weibo account ran a creative "preheat" — their mascot "Monkey Lily suddenly disappeared last night!!" and a handwritten note was found on his workstation saying he was going to see someone he'd always wanted to see. A mystery-tease launch tactic, tagged #WangYibo.
cta: none visible in the pulled text (Weibo preheat post).
idea: The mascot-disappearance mystery: a handwritten note teases a launch and turns a product preheat into a storyline.
sequencing: Mystery: the Monkey Lily mascot disappeared overnight.
Clue: a handwritten note found on his workstation.
Tease: he's going to see someone he'd always wanted to see.
Framing: "the brand now using the diff ways of preheat."
formatting: Short text + photo. Playful mystery tone with emoji.
why_it_works: A disappearance creates an open loop with zero ad feel — followers investigate a story, not a product, and the handwritten note is the native-format vehicle.
what_to_steal: The mascot-mystery preheat for LC launches: a handwritten note "from" the jewelry box / a missing piece storyline that turns a drop into a 48-hour mystery the audience follows.
